candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on proper names and alphanumeric identifier tokens across multiple languages and scripts.
This feature activates strongly on the Thai consonant letter 'ว' (wo waen) and its various combining vowel and tone mark sequences.
This feature vector represents the Thai vowel sign sara ii combined with various consonant or vowel characters.
This vector activates on the Thai vowel character 'ำ' and its corrupted encoding representations.
This vector activates on capitalized proper nouns, names, and specific entities across multiple languages and scripts.
This feature vector activates strongly on mixed-script tokens containing Thai characters and specific Latin-script fragments or numerals.
This feature vector represents the letter combination "Ma" or words starting with the capital letter "M".
This vector activates for parts of proper nouns, particularly names and surnames.
This feature vector represents visual entertainment media and art forms such as television, film, and music.
This vector represents common prefixes and foundational morphemes used in multilingual brand names and titles.
